title: Essence
excerpt: Absolute truth as a coin whose other side is disgust — and an essence that mocks you into nothing before it completes you.

body: I hope it may be obvious at this point, but I do aim to draw a strict and clear distinction between what I currently know as absolute truth and conceptualized theory drawn from my imagination. I will begin with discussing what I do and absolutely know as truth. When it comes to the intelligent essence embedded into reality, I certainly know about the nature of this essence through direct experience. The essence that draws synchronicity from thin air. The essence that seems to have memory. It will remind you of the smallest of details long ago packed in the sweetest way. The essence gifts are infinitely sweet. Sweet sweet. The essence can remind you of the darkness too. Instead of sweet nectar pouring through you, it may show you a leaf of absolute disgust and repulsiveness. In my experience, the leaf that is turned to me from the essence is directly related to my relationship with the world around me and myself. And even a skeptic such as I was convinced to know this essence is certainly real. Even when I once believed I am simply seeing the world through my own cognitive lens, the essence would throw me the most intricate, synchronistic experiences to crumble this perspective. This essence knows your deepest secrets.

When essence is exposed to you, this knowing of your secrets on the wrong side of the coin will make you feel mocked and ridiculed and crumble you and your identity to a complete nothingness. It may mock you so violently and mercilessly that you will be reduced to void. On the more desirable part of this coin, the essence will make you feel wonders beyond your imagination. Will uplift you into your utmost complete and fulfilled self. The sweet nectar given from the essence will make you float and have all gifted to you. You are freed after this overwhelming pleasure is handed to you. The pleasure only excites you into a state where much more desirable gifts and pleasures are drawn to you.

One may immediately ask: "how can I experience this pleasure and feel the essence?" In truth, I don't certainly know the answer. I only have theories of how one can begin to dance with the essence. This involves the conversations of faith, where prahna, kundalini awakening, hemi synch, the union of opposites, meditation, raising your consciousness, vibration, quantum could be to each other and manipulated (because my ideas of higher dimensional space is strictly conceptual and I do not have enough scientific education to be able to claim this topic of conversation with such certainty [although I can argue]).
